title: Projects
text:
Fashion & Apparel Job Market Analysis

Analytics opportunities in the fashion and apparel industry
Analyzed job postings to understand hiring patterns, salary information, geographic distribution, work arrangements, and experience requirements in the fashion and apparel sector.
Tools: Python · Pandas · Plotly · PySpark · Quarto · GitHub





Top employers in the selected market







Job postings by state




Key areas:

Employer hiring patterns
Salary ranges
Geographic distribution
Remote and hybrid work
Experience requirements

The project combines data preparation, exploratory analysis, interactive visualization, and business interpretation to provide a clearer view of opportunities within the industry.
View Project Repository →

title: Projects
text:
Corporate 10-K Analysis Using NLP

Comparing corporate disclosures with natural language processing
Applied natural language processing and machine learning techniques to analyze and compare corporate 10-K filings and identify patterns across company disclosures.
Tools: Python · NLP · TF-IDF · Word2Vec · GloVe · FAISS
Key areas:

Text preprocessing
Document similarity
TF-IDF representations
Word embeddings
Machine learning classification
Retrieval-based analysis

The project demonstrates how unstructured financial text can be transformed into structured analytical information and evaluated using multiple NLP approaches.

title: Projects
text:
Customer Segmentation & Business Analysis

Identifying actionable customer segments
Analyzed customer-level business data to identify patterns in purchasing behavior, customer value, and engagement.
Tools: Python · Data Analysis · Segmentation · Visualization
Key areas:

Customer behavior
Revenue contribution
Customer segmentation
At-risk customer identification
Business recommendations

The analysis shows how customer-level data can support retention strategies and more targeted business decisions.

title: About
text:
I am currently pursuing an M.S. in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University Metropolitan College. My academic focus is on using data, analytics, and business intelligence to solve practical business problems and support better decision-making.
Before beginning my graduate studies, I worked as a Market Research Analyst in the retail sector. My work involved analyzing market trends, competitive developments, consumer behavior, and industry dynamics. This experience strengthened my interest in combining business understanding with analytical methods.


My primary areas of interest include:

Business analytics
Business intelligence
Data visualization
Machine learning
Natural language processing
Cloud analytics
Strategic and market analysis

I enjoy working on projects where data can be transformed into clear insights that help explain business performance, customer behavior, market opportunities, and operational trends.



M.S. in Applied Business Analytics
Boston University Metropolitan College
Post Graduate Program in Data Science and Business Analytics
McCombs School of Business, The University of Texas at Austin



Before graduate school, I worked in market research with a focus on the retail sector. My responsibilities included analyzing industry trends, evaluating market developments, developing forecasts, and preparing research to support business decision-making.
That experience gave me a strong foundation in structured research, analytical thinking, and communicating complex findings clearly.



My long-term goal is to work in roles that combine analytics, business intelligence, and strategic decision-making. I am particularly interested in opportunities where I can use data to improve business performance, support leadership decisions, and build scalable analytical solutions.



I continue to strengthen my technical skills through coursework and hands-on projects. My current tools and areas of experience include:

Python
R
SQL
Excel
Tableau
Power BI
PySpark
Machine learning
Natural language processing
Data visualization
Cloud analytics




Outside academics and professional work, I enjoy spending time with family, traveling, exploring new places and cultures, and creative activities.
I am also curious about how technology and AI are changing the way people work and make decisions, which often inspires the kinds of projects and topics I like to explore.
